Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.11996

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of March 2023).
source_name: Nino Bašić, Martin Knor and Riste Škrekovski, “On regular graphs with Šoltés vertices”, arXiv:2303.11996 (2024).
statement: A **Šoltés graph** is a graph $G$ for which deleting any vertex leaves the Wiener index unchanged. **Regularity conjecture.** If $G$ is a Šoltés graph, then $G$ is regular. This conjecture proposes that every solution to the Šoltés problem has all vertices of the same degree; the source gives no resolution.
title: Regularity conjecture for Šoltés graphs
